market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months as oil-driven inflation keeps RBA on hold or hawkish, iron ore weakness drags materials, and AUD weakness feeds import costs. Expect volatility around RBA commentary and US Fed meeting. Key support test on S&P/ASX 200.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if iron ore stabilises and housing correction completes. Superannuation reform and energy transition (Santos model) create structural opportunities. AI capex normalisation may redirect capital to cash-generative Australian equities.
